name: Agent Memory Plugin
description: An agent runtime's governed memory inside the brain: write back what a task decided, learnt and produced (each memory captured as a thought, waiting for review unless a person confirmed it), recall a workspace's memories by meaning ranked by provenance and review, record which were used, review them, and read a recall's trace. Ported from the Agent Memory API integration's standalone server and the Agent Memory schema (SMD-2690).
